use_case_name: Create and Print a Voucher Batch

claims.content: The VMU User creates and prints a batch of vouchers with unique identification numbers, security codes, and bar-code formats for distribution and tracking within the voucher management system.

goal.raw_text: The VMU User creates and prints a batch of vouchers with unique identification numbers, security codes, and bar-code formats for distribution and tracking within the voucher management system.

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU User initiates the creation and printing of a voucher batch when a minimum quantity requirement is determined by the management team or upon operational need for distribution.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the creation and printing of a voucher batch when a minimum quantity requirement is determined by the management team or upon operational need for distribution.

claims.content: The VMU User initiates the voucher creation process, where the system generates unique voucher numbers with built-in security protocols.
The system assigns a Project Code (2 Digit), Group Batch Code (3 Digit), Batch Number (2 Digit), Voucher Number (10 digit), and Security Code to each voucher in the batch.
The system prints all codes (Batch number, Voucher number, Security Code) in the form of Bar-code on the voucher.
The system includes MRP (maximum retail price) on each voucher.

The system formats the voucher with three tear-off portioned slips: first for initial consultation, second for first follow-up, third for final (second follow-up), plus a sub-section tear-off for the partner.
Each voucher slip contains the bar code of the voucher with two identifications — one for the client and one for the partner.
If configured as stickers, the tear-off slips are designed so they will not be lost when attached to claim forms by the VSP.
Each voucher in the batch has a unique identification number composed of a Project Code (2 Digit), Group Batch Code (3 Digit), Batch Number (2 Digit), Voucher Number (10 digit), and Security Code.
All codes (Batch number, Voucher number, Security Code) are printed on the voucher in the form of a Bar-code.
Each voucher includes the MRP (maximum retail price).

Each voucher is formatted with three tear-off portioned slips: one for initial consultation, one for first follow-up, and one for final (second follow-up), plus a sub-section tear-off for the partner.
Each voucher slip contains the bar code of the voucher with two identifications — one for the client and one for the partner.
If configured as stickers, the tear-off slips are designed so they will not be lost when attached to claim forms by the VSP.
The system provides a validity date check for the period of vouchers, which can be amended or altered at the system level ONLY by the authorized user.
